title: allophylus zeylanicus var. acuminatus

This plant is traditionally used in medicine and has been reported to possess various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and protect against oxidative stress.
